depth_charts.why: point-in-time depth selection. pos_slot is the vendor tiebreak within pos_abb and exists only on the raw blob.
QB room ordering at a cut. This is the `captured_depth_chart` call the spec named as an undeclared glob; it is now declared.
joins retained raw files to the manifest by content hash.

espn_injuries_json.why: designation text per player at a cut, kept verbatim.

injuries.why: the espn glob pattern also matches the `injuries` family name; declared so the audit is not satisfied by a coincidence.
joins retained raw files to the manifest by content hash.

schedules.why: orders schedule blobs by manifest transaction time to pick the newest lawful one; projects no column.

the week capture plan: which games exist and when they kick off. A kickoff time is scheduled months ahead and is not an outcome. The same blob carries result, home_score, spread_line and total_line and this reader takes none of them.
joins retained raw files to the manifest by content hash.

coach_prior is the selected estimator for three of five volume metrics, so the head coach per team is a prediction-time input. home_coach/away_coach are reached through an f-string, which is why a literal scan missed them and a person had to read it.

vintage_manifest.why: builds the Fact list every cut check is judged on.
locates the evidence blob for a live game.
measures per-source capture age against a declared expiry, and reports which tree it measured in. It feeds no projection.
stamps the vintage of each gating input onto the gate record.
resolves which captured bytes a non-QB layer ran on.
clocks the depth-chart blobs it selects among.
the sanctioned point-in-time selector. It is a declared reader like any other; being the intended channel does not exempt it.

weekly_rosters.why: resolves a kicking-layer row id to a named player, so a DFS entrant is keyed by player and not by (team, position).
the kicker of record per club. Player-keyed, never (team, position): that substitution is what OUT-023 was about.
maps a roster status code to one participation class.
roster membership at a cut. The reduced vintage drops `status`, so the retained raw files under nfl_vintage/raw are the only source.
position attach for the rushing conversion frame.
joins retained raw files to the manifest by content hash.
rehearsal slate membership from the reduced vintage.

not_implemented: PHASE_2: a read(node, cut) accessor. Every read below still happens by globbing a directory; the declaration bounds who reads what, it does not mediate the bytes.
PHASE_3: content-addressed recomputation ACROSS RUNS. The identity algebra and the cache exist and are exercised inside a run; nothing is persisted between runs yet.

runtime_keyed_reads.bounded_by: the path is the `blob` field of the manifest row being checked, so the reachable set is the manifest's own. No CSV is parsed and no column is projected: the read is a lowercase substring test.
runtime_keyed_reads.why: substring-checks a captured blob for the team codes a manifest row claims it covers, so a row cannot assert coverage the bytes do not carry.

runtime_keyed_reads.bounded_by: the path is the file this call created from bytes already in hand. NOTE, and it is a finding of this audit rather than a repair: the `delivered_injury_evidence` blob family is in nfl/vintage/ and is in neither registry.REGISTRY nor registry.DELIVERED, so no source name exists to declare an edge to. Naming it is a capture-layer change and is not made here.
runtime_keyed_reads.why: reads back the blob it has just written and refuses if the gzip round-trip does not hash to the same sha256.

runtime_keyed_reads.bounded_by: both the source name and the content hash in the path come from the manifest row being recovered, and the recovered hash is compared back against that row.
runtime_keyed_reads.why: re-derives the content hash of a retained raw file to recover the provenance of a manifest row whose blob is missing.
